# Lions Den Candle Company is selling the sweet smell of summer - COMMUNITY & EVENTS ByJalyn Green Saturday, June 8, 2024 REHOBOTH BEACH, Delaware -- Jacob Anthony is the owner and CEO of The Lions Den Candle Company in Rehoboth Beach, Delaware\. Anthony makes handcrafted soy candles, diffusers, wax melts and soaps\. He started in 2020, making candles as gifts with his new additional time working remotely\. As the demand for his candles grew, he turned his hobby into a business with the help of his husband Tony Zacchei\. In 2021, The Lions Den Candle Company became Jacob's full-time business\. During the summer, The Lions Den Candle Company sells products at the Rehoboth Beach Farmer's Market and during the winter at Philadelphia's Christmas Village\. House and Senate, led the National Farmers Union, and later became the first CEO of Growth Energy\. - He now serves as CEO of the American Carbon Alliance\. No one should be surprised by the latest reportsshowing Iowa farm income has fallen sharply\. Commodity prices are abysmal, input costs remain high, and farm families continue to do what they've always done: Work harder, spend less, and hope next year brings better conditions\. America's farmers have never wanted to depend on government assistance\. What they have always wanted is the opportunity to compete, innovate and sell more of what they produce\. Throughout our history, agriculture has prospered when we've opened new markets, not when we've expanded government programs\. And the opportunity is here\. # The Farmer Companies Raises $17 Million Series A And Names Randy Johnson CEO By Amit Chowdhry Today at 2:04 PM The Farmer Companies has raised $17 million in Series A financing and appointed former Dot’s Pretzels CEO Randy Johnson as chief executive officer\. Raff Ventures led the funding round, with participation from AJAX Capital Partners\. Johnson succeeds founder Adam Farmer, who will remain actively involved as chairman\. The leadership change follows The Farmer Companies’ acquisition of WHISPS and supports its strategy of building a leading North American cheese-snacking business\. Johnson previously led Dot’s Pretzels, increasing the company’s annual sales from $19 million to $250 million in approximately three years\. Hershey acquired the business for $1\.2 billion in 2021\. The Farmer Companies’ portfolio includes WHISPS Cheese Crisps and an exclusive licensing partnership with Cabot Creamery to produce Cabot Creamery Popcorn\. The company described Cabot Creamery Popcorn as the fastest-growing U\.S\. food popcorn brand among the 13 leading brands tracked by NielsenIQ\. He will report to President and CEO Zachary N\. Carpenter, who held the Chief Business Officer role until July 1, 2026\. Pasdar brings over **25 years of experience** in agricultural finance, lending, capital markets, and business leadership\.
